title: santaloides minor subsp. microphylla
intro: Santaloides minor subsp. microphylla, commonly known as Black Sandalwood, is a species of plant in the Santalaceae family, native to the tropical regions of North Queensland and New Guinea. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in reducing fever, pain, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Black Sandalwood include its ability to act as a local anesthetic, antimicrobial agent, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Black Sandalwood include sesquiterpenoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
